title: 200 Hour Yoga Teacher Training in Uluwatu Bali
metaTitle: 200 Hour Yoga Teacher Training in Uluwatu Bali
metaDescription: Join our 200 Hour Yoga Teacher Training in Uluwatu. Yoga Alliance certified 25-day immersion with Hatha & Vinyasa, meditation, philosophy & ocean views.
summary: You will learn how to teach confidently, how to safely adjust students, and how to design classes that can actually benefit people.
intro: At Bali Yoga School in Uluwatu our 200 Hour Yoga Teacher Training is not just about learning poses, it's about becoming the best version of yourself that has been inside you all along.

You will be studying in a quiet location, which is ideally located - only 15 minutes drive to the beautiful beaches and everything you need in town. It is peaceful enough to concentrate totally on what you are learning but you never feel alone in the vibrant local culture that makes Bali so special.

The distinguishing feature of our training is its comprehensiveness. You will learn the physical postures, sure, but you will also learn the underlying meaning behind them. You will find out how to teach confidently, how to safely adjust students, and how to design classes that can actually benefit people. Above all, you will learn how to live yoga – not only practice it one hour a day.

Just imagine your day here: morning practice with the gentle ocean breeze, diving into the lessons learning about yoga philosophy and how to teach yoga, and evenings where you can relax, contemplate or do what you like in the local area. This natural rhythm of this place helps in all that you are trying to learn.
durationStatements: What if your life could completely transform in just 25 days?

dining.text: We serve plant-based meals, prepared with the highest standards of hygiene, cleanliness, and love to support your yoga journey. By following a plant-based diet during your training, you are in the practice of ahimsa.
mealTimes: Lunch & Dinner are not served on Sundays.

prerequisites: A high level of self-motivation is essential for all aspects of the course. The practice, and especially the teaching of yoga, require a strong sense of self-discipline and purity.

policies.title: Discipline Rules
items: Always maintain discipline, respect the teachers, and follow all rules.
Always be on time; late arrivals will not be permitted to join the class.
Visitors are not allowed to stay in the accommodation.
Attendance in all classes is mandatory. Leave may only be taken in cases of emergency or illness, and must be approved by the respective teacher.
Uninformed absences will not be accepted and will negatively impact the student's monthly performance.

policies.title: Refund Policy
items: Deposits are non-refundable, but can be transferred to other upcoming courses at Bali Yoga School in any locations. The deposit is valid for a lifetime.
